chunks.title: Back Order
chunks.heading: Solution › Back Order
chunks.text:
When the user creates a Sales Order with the Fulfilment Type set to Back Order and confirms the order, the system shall display a New PO (GMPO) option against the respective Order Confirmation (OC).
The generated GMPO can be accessed through either:
• The New PO (GMPO) option available on the Order Confirmation, or
• The GMPO Pending List screen.
The system shall allow the user to generate the Material Requirement List (MRL) from the GMPO. Upon successful MRL generation, the system shall automatically create Material Indents for the required material types based on the BOM and material requirements.
Back Order – To Be
When the user creates a Sales Order with the Order Type set to CM, the field OC Factory shall be displayed as Supplier. The user shall select the Supplier, add the required article(s), and confirm the order.
Upon confirmation of the Sales Order, the system shall automatically create a GMPO for the ordered style. The generated GMPO shall be available in the GMPO Pending List within the Sourcing module, from where the user can proceed with the standard purchase order generation process.
Additionally, the corresponding Style Indent shall be available in the Pending MRP List, enabling the user to generate and process the Style Indent, if required, through the existing Indent Management workflow.

chunks.title: Back Order
chunks.heading: Solution › Back Order
chunks.text: This enhancement enables CM orders to be fulfilled through direct procurement from the selected supplier while retaining the flexibility to process the associated Style Indent via the MRP and Indent Management modules.

chunks.title: Purchase
chunks.heading: Solution › Purchase
chunks.text:
Purchase Order - As is
When the user creates a Sales Order with the Fulfilment Type set to Purchase and confirms the order, the system shall automatically generate Style Indents for the ordered styles.
The generated Style Indents shall be available in the respective Indent Management module, where the user can perform all supported indent-related operations such as review, approval, modification, purchase order generation, and further procurement activities as per the existing workflow.
Purchase Order – To Be
When a user creates a Manufacturing Sales Order, but intends to procure the finished style instead of manufacturing it, the system shall provide an option to fulfil the requirement through direct purchase.
After running MRP, the system shall display:
• Level 1: Style Indent
• Level 2: Material Indents
A new field, Purchase Demand, shall be available at Level 1 (Style Indent). The user can specify the quantity of the style to be procured directly (for example, entering 1,000 as the Purchase Demand for a Sales Order quantity of 1,000).

chunks.title: Purchase
chunks.heading: Solution › Purchase
chunks.text:
During the subsequent MRP run, the system shall reduce or eliminate the generation of Material Indents based on the Purchase Demand quantity. If the entire Style Indent quantity is marked as Purchase Demand, no Material Indents shall be generated for that quantity, as the style will be sourced directly from the vendor instead of being manufactured.

chunks.title: MTS
chunks.heading: Solution › MTS
chunks.text:
1. Business Scenario
In the Make to Stock (MTS) process, products are manufactured in advance and stored in inventory. When a customer Sales Order is received, the available inventory is allocated to that Sales Order through the Material Allocation screen.
This functionality enables businesses to fulfill customer demand from existing stock without creating a Sales ASN for the Make to Stock Sales Order.

4. Functional Requirements
FR-01 – Make to Stock Sales Order
The system shall allow users to create a Sales Order with:
• Order Type = Make to Stock
• Fulfillment Type = Manufacturing
FR-02 – Production
The system shall allow production to be completed against the Make to Stock Sales Order. Upon completion, the finished goods shall be added to inventory.
FR-03 – Inventory
The produced inventory shall remain available until it is allocated to another Sales Order.
FR-04 – Sales ASN
The system shall not generate a Sales ASN for a Make to Stock Sales Order.
FR-05 – Customer Sales Order
The system shall allow users to create another Sales Order with Fulfillment Type = Purchase Order.
FR-06 – Material Allocation

chunks.title: MTS
chunks.heading: Solution › MTS
chunks.text:
During Sales Order Adjustment, the Material Allocation screen shall display the available inventory generated from Make to Stock Sales Orders.
The screen shall display:
• Source MTS Sales Order
• Item
• Warehouse
• Available Quantity
• Allocated Quantity
• Balance Quantity
FR-07 – Stock Allocation
The user shall be able to allocate available MTS inventory to the selected Sales Order.
After allocation:
• Available inventory shall be reduced.
• Allocation records shall be updated.
• Remaining inventory shall continue to be available for future allocations.
